items.new_text: Given a Claude Code plugin repository whose code is Python, when a stack profile is chosen for a new project by name, then a bundled profile for plugin projects exists, is reported valid, and carries the same Python version, test command and lint command as the generic Python profile together with the plugin projects' architecture rules.

Given an existing repository is analysed for adoption, when it is a Python repository (a pyproject.toml at the root and no JavaScript dependencies) with a .claude-plugin folder at the root or under plugins/*/, then the plugin-project profile is matched; a repository of another language keeps its match; and a Python-only repository without that folder still matches the generic Python profile.

Given a bundled profile's architecture rule names a checking mechanism, when the profiles are checked, then every named file exists in the shipped plugins or shared folders and is registered where it runs, and a checker that nothing runs is stated as instruction only.
